sessions.phase_label: Initial concept review and design refinement
Editable-format remediation and final asset handoff

requirements.title: Premium Report Visual Design
requirements.definition: Provide a polished, commercially presentable visual design with a consistent theme across all vehicle-security report versions.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the shared visual language and commercial finish; individual dashboard, section, header, footer, and copy behaviors remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Front-Page Result Dashboard
requirements.definition: Present the vehicle security score, risk outcome, exposure and priority information prominently and immediately on the opening page.
requirements.boundary_note: Score prominence, dashboard spacing, the Vehicle Security Score heading, and associated result fields are attributes of one opening-result mechanism.

requirements.title: Scannable Result Explanation
requirements.definition: Summarize the primary causes and weaknesses behind the result on page one using concise, readily scannable content.
requirements.boundary_note: The result explanation can be shortened or reformatted independently of the score dashboard and therefore remains a separate Requirement.

requirements.title: Vehicle Group Presentation
requirements.definition: Display the applicable vehicle group or assessed vehicle as a finished customer-facing line rather than an incomplete-looking checkbox form.
requirements.boundary_note: This presentation behavior can be changed independently of the dashboard and other front-page content.

requirements.title: Scoring Summary Table
requirements.definition: Provide an understandable scoring table showing each scoring category, its maximum score, the customer score, and the total score.
requirements.boundary_note: The category rows and score fields are attributes of one transparent scoring-summary mechanism rather than separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Prioritized Security Upgrade Path
requirements.definition: Present recommended security actions as a practical upgrade path ranked by priority.
requirements.boundary_note: Immediate actions, priority upgrades, and secondary upgrades are ranking attributes of one recommendation mechanism.

requirements.title: Confidential Distribution Warning
requirements.definition: Retain a clear confidentiality and limited-distribution warning while keeping its visual treatment refined and subordinate to the page content.
requirements.boundary_note: Warning content and visual prominence are tightly coupled attributes of one final-page warning section; footer presence is independently testable.

requirements.title: Editable Customer-Specific Fields
requirements.definition: Allow customer-specific report data, scores, identifiers, dates, weaknesses, recommendations, and notes to be edited cleanly for each assessment.
requirements.boundary_note: Individual editable fields are parameters of one reusable-template behavior; delivery in Word or Canva is a separate artifact-format obligation.

requirements.title: RR01–RR04 Report Variant Set
requirements.definition: Provide four distinct report templates, RR01 through RR04, mapped to the appropriate severe, elevated, reduced, and lower exposure levels.
requirements.boundary_note: The four variants form one selectable risk-level set; cross-page report-code correctness and risk-specific narrative wording can fail independently and remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Risk-Appropriate Report Copy
requirements.definition: Ensure report narrative is professionally worded and semantically appropriate to the exposure level of each report variant.
requirements.boundary_note: Includes isolated typo, sentence-quality, and exposure-specific wording corrections as attributes of customer-facing narrative accuracy; layout and identifier consistency are excluded.

requirements.title: Internal-Page Header
requirements.definition: Display a subtle, space-efficient header on internal report pages containing the appropriate report identity and confidentiality information.
requirements.boundary_note: Header presence and styling are independently changeable from footer presence; exact per-version report-code correctness is tracked separately.

requirements.title: Consistent Page Footer
requirements.definition: Use a clean, consistent footer on every report page, including the final page containing the distribution warning.
requirements.boundary_note: Footer presence and visual consistency constitute one recurring page mechanism; per-version code accuracy is independently testable.

requirements.title: Per-Variant Report Code Consistency
requirements.definition: Use the correct RR-01, RR-02, RR-03, or RR-04 identifier consistently throughout each corresponding report, including details, headers, and footers.
requirements.boundary_note: Identifier accuracy has its own repeated failure and correction trajectory across cover details, headers, and footers, distinct from their visual layout.

requirements.title: Editable Word Templates
requirements.definition: Deliver editable Microsoft Word versions of the report templates.
requirements.boundary_note: Word delivery is retained separately because it was completed while the independently required Canva and PDF deliverables remained outstanding.

requirements.title: Editable Canva Templates
requirements.definition: Deliver editable Canva templates for RR01, RR02, RR03, and RR04 that the client can use for future customer reports.
requirements.boundary_note: Canva delivery has a distinct dispute and partial-delivery trajectory and therefore cannot be merged with Word templates or PDF exports.

requirements.title: Final PDF Exports
requirements.definition: Deliver final customer-ready PDF exports for RR01, RR02, RR03, and RR04.
requirements.boundary_note: Final PDF files are independently deliverable artifacts rather than an attribute of the editable Canva or Word source formats.

requirements.title: Design Asset Handoff
requirements.definition: Provide the fonts, icons, logos, colour codes, and other design assets needed to edit and export future reports independently.
requirements.boundary_note: Fonts, icons, logos, colour codes, and related resources form one supporting asset package; they are separate from the report files themselves.

unresolved_candidates.description: The client identifies an attached image as the desired front-box reference, but the image is unavailable, so its exact visual requirements cannot be recovered from message text.
The client requests minor changes shown only in an attached image; the unavailable attachment prevents safe discovery or routing of those specific changes.
